intro.title: Multi-Step Form
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a multi-step form using Vue, which allows users to progress through a form in stages, like a sign-up or checkout process. You will learn how to manage the current step state and conditionally display different form sections based on that state. The main technologies involved are Vue's reactive data properties, conditional rendering with v-if or v-show, and event handling for navigation buttons. By the end, you'll have a functional form that guides users through multiple steps with clear navigation.
intro.usecase: Multi-step forms are essential in real-world applications where complex data collection needs to be broken down into manageable sections. You'll see this pattern in e-commerce checkout flows, user onboarding processes, insurance quote calculators, and job application platforms. As a Vue developer, you'll implement these interfaces to guide users through sequential tasks while maintaining application state between steps. This approach improves user experience by reducing cognitive load and preventing form abandonment during lengthy data entry processes.
